spec: §15 suite F (envelope and hashes); §9.2: object_hash is taken over the canonical text with the schedule, certificate and coverage sections deleted together with the preceding blank line
derivation: sched_inc8.bisa is inc8.bisa plus one schedule section; deleting it (with its preceding blank line) reproduces the inc8 bytes, so its object_hash equals C-163-inc8-check's 8093da48... and the symbol hashes are unchanged.
